pages.title: Maxwell's Demon Sorter
pages.text: Built a demon of my own: the $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$(), a molecular gatekeeper that sorts fast particles from slow ones, defying the second law of thermodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
By the books it should not work: sorting particles lowers entropy, and someone always pays. See my notes on Maxwell's Demon. For now I just watch it sort.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dilaton Crystal, Inflaton Field, Kaluza-Klein Shard, Maxwell's Demon Chip, Moduli Crystal, Negentropy Cell, Planck Shard, Strange Matter Pellet, Universe Seed, Void Lattice Shard, Warm Helium.
